meta.name: runbook
meta.description: Write an operating runbook from the delivered system and verified procedures. Use when the customer team or a successor needs to operate without the original engineer.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把已交付的系统整理成别人能照着独立运维的操作手册
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果系统要交给客户或接替者独立运维,却没人记下操作步骤。
copy.tagline_en: Turn a delivered system into an operating manual others can follow on their own
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you're handing a system to a team or successor who must run it without you

howto.what: 它会基于已交付的系统和已验证的流程,写出一份运行手册(runbook),让客户团队或接手的人在没有原工程师的情况下也能操作。产出是一份操作手册文档。
howto.when: 当客户团队或继任者需要在没有原工程师的情况下操作这套系统时,它会接管,依据已交付的内容和已验证的流程来写手册。

say.text: 根据已交付的系统和已验证的流程,写一份运行手册给客户团队接手用。
say.note: 会按任务上下文契约产出操作手册

say.text: 整理运行手册时,把实现、验证、部署、验收分开写,不确定的地方保留为未知项。
say.note: 未知项会保留,不会补猜

say.text: 这份运行手册里,没跑过的检查请如实标注,别写成已验证。
say.note: 未执行的检查会如实报告

howto.what_en: It writes an operating runbook from the delivered system and verified procedures, so a customer team or a successor can operate the system without the original engineer. The output is a runbook document.
howto.when_en: It takes over when the customer team or a successor needs to operate the system without the original engineer, drafting the runbook from the delivered system and verified procedures.

say_en.text: Write an operating runbook from the delivered system and verified procedures for the customer team.
say_en.note: Produces the runbook under the task context contract

say_en.text: Mark any check that was not actually run as unrun, not as verified.
